meta.name: browser-automation
meta.description: Use when the user asks to automate browser tasks, scrape websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract structured data from web pages, or build web automation workflows. NOT for testing — use playwright-pro for that.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行浏览器操作，如填表、截图和提取数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器完成重复性网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser actions for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Playwright 自动操作浏览器，例如抓取网页数据、填写表单、截图、提取结构化信息，并管理会话和反检测。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化浏览器任务，如抓取网站、填写表单、截图、提取网页结构化数据，或构建浏览器自动化工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我抓取这个网页上的产品列表，包括名称和价格。
自动登录这个网站，填写表单并下载报告。
say.note: Claude 会执行登录、填表、下载的完整工作流。

say.text: 截取这个页面的全屏截图并保存为 PDF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser tasks using Playwright, such as scraping web data, filling forms, taking screenshots, extracting structured information, and managing sessions with anti-detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate browser tasks like scraping websites, filling forms, capturing screenshots, extracting structured data from web pages, or building web automation workflows.

say_en.text: Scrape the product list from this page, including names and prices.
say_en.note: Claude will use Playwright to extract data and output JSON.

say_en.text: Automate login, fill the form, and download the report.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the full workflow of login, form filling, and download.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot and save it as PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will use Playwright to capture screenshot and generate PDF.
